Use January–March 2026, the latest completed reporting quarter before publication, for the otherwise unspecified current period.
Read 'taken up' as capacity allocated to OpenAI. Microsoft running OpenAI models for its own products does not automatically count as allocation to OpenAI.

The denominator is Microsoft's GPU fleet, including capacity it controls through rentals. Electrical power, revenue shares and normalized computing performance are not interchangeable with GPU counts.
The Anthropic qualification acknowledges uncertainty; it does not specify an alternative threshold.
